answer: Agents bind identity to a live yarrow-rooted reputation vine that only grows when peers continuously attest real-time resource commitments inside a shared harbor of sequential verification slots. Each new identity must queue on the same non-parallelizable slot clock and post escalating collateral that is slashed if its attestation pattern correlates with known clusters. A farm therefore cannot batch proofs offline; every additional sybil pays both higher stake and exclusive wall-clock time, making mass forgery asymptotically expensive.
